name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
summary: In Shadowfang Keep, Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent have gone missing. High Executor Hadrec sends Horde adventurers inside to find the reconnaissance agents. Their intelligence is needed to prepare a Forsaken assault against Archmage Arugal and his worgen packs.

sections.title: Into the Worgen Den
sections.body: Silverpine Forest remains contested, and Archmage Arugal's worgen hold Shadowfang Keep. The Forsaken at the Sepulcher seek to break his siege on their southern borders. High Executor Hadrec sent Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent into the fortress to chart its defenses. Days pass without word, and Hadrec grows desperate for their reports. He sends Horde champions into the stronghold to recover the agents and salvage the operation.

sections.title: A Bitter Discovery
sections.body: The lower ramparts reveal the cost of the infiltration. Deathstalker Adamant survives in captivity and helps unbar the courtyard gates. Vincent met a brutal end; his broken corpse lies motionless within the keep, and his intelligence is lost in its dark halls. A small trinket remains clenched in his fingers, a last sign of a spy who gave his life for the Dark Lady's conquest.

faq.q: Why were Deathstalkers sent to Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec ordered the infiltration to gather tactical intelligence on Archmage Arugal's forces and fortifications before the Forsaken commit troops to an assault on Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: Who are Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent?
faq.answer: Adamant and Vincent are elite Forsaken operatives and advance scouts. They belong to the Deathstalkers, the Undercity's espionage and assassination branch, and were sent to map Shadowfang Keep and observe its worgen defenses.
Vincent has not reported back from Shadowfang Keep. Hadrec needs someone to enter the fortress and discover what happened to him.

faq.q: What role does Deathstalker Adamant play inside the keep?
faq.answer: Adamant is one of the missing Deathstalkers sent to gather intelligence inside Shadowfang Keep. His situation is learned during the search.

aliases: where to get deathstalkers in shadowfang
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec gives the assignment at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, where he is stationed as the Forsaken military commander.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken leadership want Shadowfang Keep cleared?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal unleashes violent worgen packs across Silverpine Forest from Shadowfang Keep. They constantly threaten Forsaken holdings, supply lines, and the security of Lordaeron.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, reclaiming Silverpine from Arugal's beasts is essential to securing Lordaeron. The missing scouts show the danger of that struggle.
The Deathstalkers' disappearance shows the risks of reconnaissance behind fortified enemy lines.
High Executor Hadrec relies on Horde champions to support Forsaken operations when conventional troops cannot breach Arugal's cursed fortress.
